studies.title: The tulip
studies.caption: A tulip rises from a bulb that survives beneath the ground. Gardeners carried these flowers from Central Asian landscapes into Persian, Ottoman and European gardens.
studies.prompt: Low botanical field view of a few wild Tulipa greigii in Central Asian rocky foothill grass, red six-tepal cup flowers, broad slightly mottled leaves at base, one flower turned to show dark centre. No dense Dutch commercial field, no striped virus fantasy, no people.
